mass.limitation: Mixed-material subsystem mass uses nominal densities and vendor/drawing mass overrides; fastener and lubricant micro-masses are screening values.

rejected_spring.basis: Inherited rate was read as N/mm although manufacturer table value 8.7504 was kg/mm; corrected SI rate is 85.815 N/mm. Excess force and only 3.51 mm solid-height margin make the inherited installation unsuitable.

selected_spring.basis: Manufacturer-catalog dimensions; configuration selected to fit the r=18 core and provide zero-GS completion margin. Procurement certificate and incoming rate/length inspection remain required.
